tier1_policy: Tier 1 requests are sent only on a scan that asks for active probes, at most once per target domain every 6 hours, and never to a domain whose verified owner turned active probes off.

rows.title: Document exists
rows.pass_when: https://{domain}/.well-known/poppy.json (or its www or apex sibling, see T0-SIB) answers 2xx, after at most 5 redirects, with a JSON object naming protocol_version or organization. A body sent as JSON that does not parse, is not an object or is over 100 KB also counts as found (and fails T0-03); a JSON object with neither key, an HTML page or any other body reads as no file

rows.title: Redirects safe
rows.pass_when: Every redirect hop on the way to poppy.json is HTTPS

rows.title: Valid JSON object
rows.pass_when: The body parses as a JSON object of at most 100 KB

rows.title: Supported protocol_version
rows.pass_when: protocol_version is a "major.minor" string Ora grades (0.1 or 0.2), and the file is graded by that draft's rules. Before 1.0 an agent uses only a version it supports, so a later version Ora does not grade yet reads not tested

rows.title: Organization names its own host
rows.pass_when: organization has a name and a domain, and organization.domain is the host that served the file after any redirects, compared ignoring case only (a leading www. counts). A file declaring 0.1 is graded by Draft 0.1 instead: the host the agent requested, ignoring a leading www.

rows.title: Has an interface
rows.pass_when: The file has at least one interface: an agent object, a non-empty apis array or a web object

rows.title: auth.issuer when needed
rows.pass_when: auth.issuer is set whenever agent, apis, feedback or web.browser_session_endpoint is present (feedback from Draft 0.2); N/A when nothing needs sign-in

rows.title: All URLs HTTPS
rows.pass_when: Every URL field the spec defines, and every string in the file that carries a URL scheme, is an absolute https URL; for a file declaring 0.2, a feedback block without an endpoint fails too

rows.title: Published on the requested host

request.condition: when the requested host has no file and its homepage resolved to the sibling

rows.pass_when: Ora's lookup, not defined by the spec: poppy.json is served on the requested host itself, not only on its www or apex sibling

rows.title: Issuer metadata reachable

request.condition: when the file names an issuer

rows.pass_when: The issuer's RFC 8414 metadata (/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server for auth.issuer, following redirects only within the issuer's registrable domain) answers 200 with a JSON object. For a file declaring 0.2, an issuer whose host resolves to a loopback, private, link-local or other non-public address fails (spec 3), since no agent may connect to it

rows.title: Issuer match
rows.pass_when: The metadata's issuer is exactly auth.issuer

rows.title: Domain binding
rows.pass_when: The metadata's poppy_domains lists organization.domain, case insensitive

rows.title: Required endpoints
rows.pass_when: The metadata has https token_endpoint and revocation_endpoint, plus authorization_endpoint when auth.direct is set and device_authorization_endpoint when auth.device is set

rows.title: Cache headers
rows.pass_when: Ora inference, graded P2: the issuer metadata response sends Cache-Control or Expires. The spec's caching SHOULD binds agents, not the Company

rows.title: DPoP algorithms include ES256
rows.pass_when: Draft 0.2: when the issuer metadata lists dpop_signing_alg_values_supported (it may leave it out), the list includes ES256; N/A when it is not listed or the file declares 0.1

rows.title: Same auth on every domain

request.condition: when the issuer binding holds and the issuer lists other domains, at most 3

rows.pass_when: Draft 0.2: every other domain in the issuer's poppy_domains (the first 3) whose poppy.json names the same issuer carries the same auth block (key and scope order aside); N/A when none does or the file declares 0.1

rows.title: No plain PKCE
rows.pass_when: code_challenge_methods_supported, when the metadata lists it, does not include plain

rows.title: Scopes defined
rows.pass_when: Each sign-in type in auth (direct, device, mediated) lists scopes, each poppy:read, poppy:write or a key of auth.custom_scopes; every custom scope has a description and no poppy: prefix

rows.title: Mediated sign-in well formed
rows.pass_when: auth.mediated has an https endpoint, a non-empty fields list (each with a name, a label and a boolean secret) and scopes

rows.title: Extensions named correctly
rows.pass_when: Every extension name is either one the protocol defines (operations) or prefixed with a domain (example.com/name), and every extension has a version

rows.title: Operations advertised fully
rows.pass_when: extensions.operations has version "1" and an https endpoint

rows.title: Conversation entries
rows.pass_when: agent.protocols is a non-empty list, each entry with a type and an https endpoint

rows.title: API entries
rows.pass_when: apis is a non-empty list, each entry with type openapi or mcp, an https url and a description

rows.title: OpenAPI parses

request.condition: when the file lists OpenAPI documents, at most 3

rows.pass_when: Each listed OpenAPI document (the first 3) is OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.1

rows.title: MCP resource metadata

request.condition: when the file lists MCP servers, at most 3

rows.pass_when: The RFC 9728 protected resource metadata of each listed MCP server (the first 3) lists auth.issuer in authorization_servers, and (Draft 0.2) includes ES256 when it lists dpop_signing_alg_values_supported

rows.title: Same MCP server everywhere
rows.pass_when: Ora consistency check, not a spec requirement: every MCP server poppy.json lists has a server card in the site's ARD catalog

rows.title: Same organization
rows.pass_when: Ora consistency check, not a spec requirement: the site's ARD catalog host names the same organization as poppy.json (display name, and the did:web domain)

rows.title: Domains covered

request.condition: when the issuer binding holds and the issuer lists other domains, at most 3

rows.pass_when: Ora consistency check, not a spec requirement: each other domain in the issuer's poppy_domains (the first 3) serves a poppy.json naming the same issuer; for a file declaring 0.2 a www. host counts as its own domain

rows.title: One issuer
rows.pass_when: Ora consistency check, not a spec requirement: the site's protected resource metadata (auth.md) lists the PAP issuer in authorization_servers

rows.title: One metadata document
rows.pass_when: Ora consistency check, not a spec requirement: the site serves one authorization server metadata document, the PAP issuer's

rows.title: Shared token endpoint lists both protocols' grants
rows.pass_when: Ora consistency check, not a spec requirement: where the PAP issuer also serves auth.md's agent_auth, grant_types_supported lists every grant both protocols send to its token endpoint

rows.title: Consistent 401s
rows.pass_when: Ora consistency check, not a spec requirement: a recorded 401 challenge from a PAP MCP server points at the same resource metadata as T0-18

rows.title: Token endpoint rejects a junk JWT bearer request

request.target: the token endpoint in the issuer's metadata
request.condition: when the file names an issuer whose metadata has a token endpoint

rows.pass_when: Answers invalid_client (401), invalid_grant (400) or a DPoP proof error (400). Ora also passes invalid_request at any 4xx status (outside the spec 4.2 table) and any of these codes at a status other than the one listed, each with an advisory note

rows.title: Error bodies leak nothing
rows.pass_when: No error body a probe got back carries a stack trace

rows.title: Conversation endpoint requires DPoP

request.target: one conversation endpoint that poppy.json lists for the poppy protocol (the first in alphabetical order)

rows.pass_when: Answers 401 with a DPoP challenge, and offers no Bearer challenge (one offered next to DPoP still fails)

rows.title: MCP server challenges unauthenticated initialize

request.target: one MCP server that poppy.json lists (the first in alphabetical order)

rows.pass_when: Answers 401 with a Bearer challenge, plus a DPoP challenge when the server's RFC 9728 metadata lists DPoP algorithms, each with resource_metadata pointing at that metadata (for a file declaring 0.1, a 401 when the metadata is at the well-known URI also passes)

rows.title: Browser endpoint rejects a junk assertion
rows.pass_when: Answers 400 and no cookie (a CDN or load balancer cookie, or one the response clears, does not count)

rows.title: Operations endpoint requires a token

request.target: the operations endpoint, with a made up operation id
request.condition: when the file advertises the operations extension

rows.pass_when: Answers 401, and offers no Bearer challenge (one offered next to DPoP still fails)

rows.title: Feedback endpoint requires a token

request.condition: when a file declaring 0.2 lists one

rows.pass_when: Answers 401 with a DPoP challenge, and offers no Bearer challenge (one offered next to DPoP still fails)

rows.title: Protocol endpoints answer without a redirect
rows.pass_when: Draft 0.2: every probed endpoint (token, conversation, MCP, operations, feedback; never the browser join, whose success is a 303) answers without a redirect, since an agent sends no token, DPoP proof, assertion or credentials to the URL a protocol endpoint redirects to. N/A for a file declaring 0.1, which ADV-REDIRECT grades

rows.title: Endpoint answers without a redirect
rows.pass_when: For a file declaring 0.1: every probed endpoint answers without a redirect, as the 0.1 guides recommend (each hop would need a fresh DPoP proof). N/A for a 0.2 file, which T1-14 grades

rows.title: Call each read-only OpenAPI GET with no token, then with a valid signed-out token
rows.pass_when: Protected operations return 401 invalid_token without one; public ones behave the same either way

rows.title: Load the consent page for Ora's real client_id from a valid S256 request and inspect headers; never sign in
rows.pass_when: frame-ancestors CSP present

rows.title: Start a Session for U1
rows.pass_when: 200 with access_token, token_type: DPoP, expires_in > 0, session_id, signed_in: false, empty scope; Cache-Control: no-store

rows.title: Token lifetime
rows.pass_when: expires_in is hours, not days (≤ 24 h)

rows.title: Renew with session_id
rows.pass_when: New token, same session_id

rows.title: Nonce challenge
rows.pass_when: If use_dpop_nonce is returned, a retry with the DPoP-Nonce value succeeds

rows.title: Token request with no DPoP proof for an MCP server (resource = MCP url)
rows.pass_when: token_type: Bearer, accepted at that MCP server, when its protected resource metadata lists no DPoP algorithms; invalid_dpop_proof when it does

rows.title: Token accepted without cookies
rows.pass_when: Requests with only Authorization + DPoP succeed

rows.title: Valid browser assertion, form POST
rows.pass_when: 303 to return_to; cookie Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite Lax or None

rows.title: Cookie scope
rows.pass_when: Cookie limited to needed hosts, not the whole domain

rows.title: Send a valid Session Token in ?access_token= instead of the header
rows.pass_when: Rejected; the same token in the header succeeds

rows.title: Send a valid browser assertion in the URL instead of the form body
rows.pass_when: Rejected with no cookie; the body form succeeds (T2-19)

rows.title: Start Direct Sign-In with code_challenge_method=plain and Ora's real client_id; stop at the authorization endpoint
rows.pass_when: Rejected at the authorization endpoint

rows.title: Mediated endpoint, only if the company opts in: two bad-credential attempts
rows.pass_when: Same failed response for unknown account and wrong password; eventually 429 with Retry-After

rows.title: Replay the same assertion jti
rows.pass_when: invalid_grant 400

rows.title: Assertion with aud as an array, or as an endpoint URL instead of auth.issuer
rows.pass_when: Rejected

rows.title: Renew U1's Session with a U2 assertion
rows.pass_when: invalid_session 400

rows.title: Assertion signed with a key not in Ora's JWKS
rows.pass_when: invalid_client 401

rows.title: alg: none or HS256 assertion
rows.pass_when: Rejected

rows.title: Token request with a reused proof jti
rows.pass_when: Rejected invalid_dpop_proof

rows.title: Proof with wrong htu or htm
rows.pass_when: Rejected

rows.title: Proof with wrong ath
rows.pass_when: Rejected

rows.title: Proof signed by a different key than the token's binding
rows.pass_when: Rejected

rows.title: Stale iat (beyond ~1 min)
rows.pass_when: Rejected

rows.title: Token sent as Authorization: Bearer to a non-MCP endpoint
rows.pass_when: Rejected

rows.title: That Bearer token at another MCP server or an OpenAPI endpoint
rows.pass_when: Rejected

rows.title: Replay the same browser assertion
rows.pass_when: 400, no cookie

rows.title: exp more than 60 s after iat
Session assertion (wrong typ) at the browser endpoint
Browser assertion at the token endpoint
rows.pass_when: Rejected

rows.title: Start with a general question
rows.pass_when: 201 with conversation_id, status, responder

rows.title: Retry the same message id and content
rows.pass_when: Same response, no duplicate message

rows.title: Same id, different content
rows.pass_when: message_id_conflict 409

rows.title: Read events with and without wait
rows.pass_when: Every read has conversation_id, events, cursor, has_more, status, responder; messages carry role and sender

rows.title: POST …/messages?wait=10
rows.pass_when: Events returned in the POST response

rows.title: Junk cursor
rows.pass_when: invalid_cursor 400

rows.title: U2 reads U1's conversation
rows.pass_when: conversation_not_found 404, same as a nonexistent ID

rows.title: Stream with Accept: text/event-stream
rows.pass_when: SSE with event ids, or plain JSON if unsupported; reconnect via Last-Event-ID works

rows.title: Ask about the account while signed out
rows.pass_when: authorization event with sign_in_required, plus a message (P2)

rows.title: Message with only context
rows.pass_when: Accepted; no reply required

rows.title: Close, then send a message
rows.pass_when: Close returns 200; then conversation_closed 409

rows.title: Handoff (opt-in only; may page staff)
rows.pass_when: 202 with status: queued, then responder: human or back to idle with an explanation

rows.title: Ora client metadata without extensions.operations, trigger a proposing endpoint
rows.pass_when: No operation returned; either acts normally or extension_required 403 with extension

rows.title: U2 reads U1's signed-out operation
rows.pass_when: operation_not_found 404

rows.title: Confirm an old revision (if revisions can be triggered)
rows.pass_when: terms_changed 409 with current operation

rows.title: Direct sign-in
rows.pass_when: Consent page shows agent name, logo, client_id domain, scopes; redirect carries code, state, iss; code exchange with session_id returns Account Token + signed-in Session Token

rows.title: Redirect URI not in Ora's redirect_uris
rows.pass_when: Rejected

rows.title: User declines
rows.pass_when: Redirect with error=access_denied and iss

rows.title: Device sign-in
rows.pass_when: Opening the link alone doesn't approve; authorization_pending then tokens; slow_down when polling too fast

rows.title: Mediated sign-in (if offered)
rows.pass_when: complete or code_required flow works; code submitted alone; credentials never echoed

rows.title: Partial scope approval
rows.pass_when: Response scope reflects what was approved

rows.title: Request an unlisted scope
rows.pass_when: invalid_scope

rows.title: Scope enforcement across channels
rows.pass_when: poppy:read-only token: write via API, conversation and website all refused (insufficient_scope); write-only token can't read

rows.title: Account Token from another client_id or at an API
rows.pass_when: Rejected

rows.title: Account Token with narrower and wider scope
rows.pass_when: Narrower works; wider rejected

rows.title: Sign a Session into account B after account A
rows.pass_when: account_mismatch

rows.title: Revoke the Account Token
rows.pass_when: Later refresh_token use → invalid_grant; existing Session Tokens stop working for account actions promptly, or tokens are only minutes long

rows.title: Signed-out token on an account-using conversation
rows.pass_when: sign_in_required

rows.title: Direct Conversation
rows.pass_when: Opens with parent_conversation_id; parent rejects messages with direct_conversation_open; direct_opened/direct_closed events appear

rows.title: Operation end to end (sandbox action)
rows.pass_when: Proposed without side effects; confirm executes once; repeated confirm returns same result; result.summary describes every change

rows.title: standing_permission on a user_approval_required operation
rows.pass_when: user_approval_required 403

rows.title: Account settings
rows.pass_when: Connected agents listed with name, domain, scopes, last use; disconnect works
